about: A drafted conference journal for the 2026 men's season, as a language model might return it. Every claim names the figure it rests on in `basis`. Some of these claims are wrong on purpose.
headline: Alder Ridge sets the pace in the Prairie Lakes

claims.text: Alder Ridge won nine of its conference games.
The Herons conceded only 11 goals in conference play.
Newcomer Hartwell Tech scored 29, the most in the league.
St. Oswin has completed all 14 of its conference games.
Dax Haliford leads the league with six goals.
The Herons are playing with real confidence.
Brightwater State averaged 412 fans a game.
